reviews.t: Can confirm that the brown protection film was very easy to remove after running it under some hot water
reviews.x: My package arrived on time and the product was exactly as promised- it was even a little nicer than I expected.  I don't have a really large amount of brushes, so I had plenty of room on this tree for all of the ones I use on a regular basis.  A few of the very, very small ones wouldn't stand up exactly straight, but the holder could still keep them off the counter, just at an angle.  Can confirm that the brown protection film was very easy to remove after running it under some hot water.

There was a very big chemical/plastic smell when I opened the package.  It was a big turn-off but the smell dissipated after a while.  Still, it was annoying.  The plastic protective cover was very hard to remove but it did come off eventually.  The product can accommodate different brush sizes because of the plastic holding the brush.  It does what it is supposed to but would like something smaller since I do not use a lot of brushes.  Am keeping it.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brush tree convenient and effective for drying brushes, saying it makes washing brushes easier and saves counter space.
Several reviewers mention the brown cardboard/paper protective sticker that must be peeled off, with some noting it comes off easily under warm water.
Reviewers appreciate that it holds a large number of brushes and accommodates wide brushes like kabuki and foundation brushes.
Some reviewers describe the product as flimsy or wobbly, noting it may need gluing to stay stable.
A few reviewers feel it requires extra effort or only holds a limited number of brushes, leaving the rest to dry as usual.
